After authorization with the same account, users can issue task commands from their phone, and a linked computer can read local files and operate software to complete the tasks, with progress and results sent back to the phone in real time. This helps users automatically execute tasks in scenarios such as commuting or away from their desk, improving efficiency.

In June this year, Doubao launched "Work Tasks" mode, allowing AI to directly operate local computers and browsers after authorization. This update extends control tasks to mobile, supports linking multiple computers, and enables cross-device file retrieval.
